findings.message: Replacing the own-property check with `cache[key] || fallback` changes semantics in two risky ways: (1) falsy cached values (false, 0, '', null) are incorrectly replaced by the fallback, violating the stated behavior; (2) `||` reads inherited/prototype properties (e.g., key 'toString' or '__proto__'), so a key not own-present in the cache can return a prototype value instead of the fallback. Use `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cache, key)` (or Object.hasOwn) to gate the read and return the stored value verbatim.
